trickyParts: Completeness is per watcher generation: a Rewatch (reconnect, self-health rebuild) clears it until the new scan finishes, so the two session routes answer 503 with Retry-After: 1 for that moment (usually milliseconds).

An idle-timed-out first scan is left by WithRescan: one second later the role watcher replaces itself on the same handle, repeatedly, until a scan completes; a newer Rewatch or Stop takes over and the rescan installs nothing.

The three narrowed assertions: TestARewatchThatCannotOpenTheRoleBucketMovesNothing stays on the interest watcher's error (WatchErr now joins the role watcher's, which the test's deleted role bucket makes appear at a varying time) and now also requires that neither role handle nor the role watcher's generation moved; useKV's WaitReady stays (coldRegistry registries have no role watcher; at 0c227469 WaitForCacheReady was exactly the interest watcher's); Rewatch is restored to 0c227469's strength (a failure returns at once and moves nothing), pinned by TestARewatchWhoseInterestWatcherCannotMoveMovesNothing.
deviations: Beyond the plan: the registry's own claim writes and deletes now apply to the holder view only if no recreated-bucket reset came between their epoch read and their answer (setOwnRoleHolder), so an old bucket's revision cannot fence out the new bucket's claims; pinned by TestAClaimWriteAnsweredAcrossARecreatedRoleBucketLeavesTheNewBucketsView.
